data.turoyo: kəbʕeno d mamṭət barṯi m s Qarataždin, mahazmole, elo lo kməstahlo, tayya w ṭr awyo luxat.
data.translation: ich wünsche, dass du meine Tochter dem Qaratâschdîn abnimmst. Er hat sie entführt, aber sie ist eines besseren wert; hole sie, und sie soll dir gehören

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; female human merit bearer and an undeserved treatment.

data.turoyo: i zarriyaṯxu lo məstahlo, ḥatta d miṣakro. Balki aloho obe fire mena.
data.translation: Euer Geschlecht verdient es nicht, zu verschwinden; vielleicht schenkt Gott noch Früchte von ihm.

rationale: Fills Infectum to five; lineage as merit bearer with explicit clausal outcome.

before: in negativen Sätzen: nicht verdienen, zu Schade sein für;
after: verdienen, würdig sein; in negativen Sätzen: nicht verdienen, zu Schade sein für;
rationale: Remove the false restriction to negative sentences: affirmative məstahlət d-owət u=ḥaṯn-ayḏi is already an inherited example and is confirmed by supplied 29/519. Keep one merit/worthiness sense.

summary: The evaluated person or lineage is the subject; the deserved/undeserved event is nominal with d- (du qaṭlo), clausal with d-/ḥatta d-, or omitted and recovered from threatened death or mistreatment.
Negative deserving is often paraphrased by schade or eines besseren wert in German. These paraphrases do not establish different senses or Detransitive morphology.
All supplied forms are Infectum, with or without k-/ko-. No other box or new stem is established.
Existing 29/519 decisively contradicts in negativen Sätzen as an exclusive restriction. The correction preserves sense number 1 and the old negative paraphrases.
Confirm the range of clausal government with ḥatta d- at 102/3 versus d- at 29/519; no separate construction sense is proposed from a single complementizer contrast.
Is absence of the glottal segment in məstahlat/məstahlo purely phonetic/transcriptional? Preserve the inherited base forms pending native review.
Affirmative worthiness is attested with the desired status as a d-clause; negative-only restriction is removed.
A lineage rather than an individual can be evaluated as not deserving extinction; participant extension, not a new lexical sense.
